purpose: Capability contract for ChatGPT and any future Live Link agent working on the modified Godot Android editor.
allowed_by_default: GDScript and project resources supported by the target Godot version
Scenes, nodes, scripts, materials, shaders and resources that work on Android
EditorPlugin APIs only after checking they exist and work in the Android editor build
Changes to native engine code only when guarded and built for Android ARM32 and ARM64
must_verify_before_use: Any EditorInterface or EditorPlugin API used by an addon
Any native extension, GDExtension, module or third-party library
Any filesystem, process, shell, windowing, clipboard or input API
Any renderer, shader, texture, memory or threading feature with Android-specific limits
Any feature whose availability differs between desktop editor, Android editor and exported Android game
reject_or_replace: Desktop-only editor panels, menus, dock assumptions or window-management flows
Required keyboard/mouse interactions with no touch alternative
Windows/Linux/macOS paths, shell commands or desktop executable dependencies in the Android workflow
Desktop-only plugins or native binaries without Android ARM32 and ARM64 builds
Assumptions that the Android editor has the same UI layout or API availability as the desktop editor
agent_behavior: Read this manifest before proposing or applying project operations.
Prefer the existing modified Godot Android editor and its native features.
When capability is uncertain, inspect the repository/API and mark it unverified instead of assuming desktop parity.
Keep changes scoped to the selected project ID; never infer the target from a project name alone.
After each operation, wait for the target editor's explicit result; do not claim success from message delivery alone.
